title: 第35章 我什么时候才能被远哥点名杀敌啊第36章 都是保命的东西兄弟们也爱听
slug: 骂我朝廷鹰犬我乃大秦武圣
content_zh:
人到甲板，张远右手手臂一带，手中长刀瞬间划着悬弧甩出。
“咻——”
刀锋带着刺耳尖啸，擦着船舷飞旋。
锋利的刀锋从四五个操控船桨，想将船拉回河道中间的匪寇身前划过。
鲜血，断肢。
还有断裂的木浆。
长刀“嘭”的一声扎在船舱，刀锋入木两尺。
船舷边惨呼哀嚎连城一片。
没有了人操浆，木船在河道中随着水旋，往岸边撞去。
“杀了他——”
“把他干下去！”
看张远手中无刀，几个持刀匪寇嘶吼着，奔行冲上来。
不将张远赶下船，他们只能死！
空着双手的张远往前一步踏出，双臂抬起。
山岳拳法，搬山拿岳。
“嘭——”
两个长刀斩落的匪寇被直接撞飞身体，砸落在两丈外的船舱，撞碎了船舱五寸厚木板，跌落进去。
这一击，让其他两个冲来的匪寇脚步停住，面色惨白。
太强！
张远展现的实力，超出了他们的应对范围。

张远脚步不停，左臂抬起。
进步，撞肘。
铁甲拳，悬天肘。
“嘭——”
粗壮的桅杆应声而断，其上挂着的白色帆布随着桅杆倒落，将船舱和甲板覆盖，也将几个匪寇盖住。
一柄长刀从帆布和缆绳之间向着张远刺来。
张远左手抬起，手臂一格。
“当——”
长刀断裂。
张远伸手抓住断刀刀刃，顺手扎在那出刀的匪寇肩窝，刀锋从其右肩扎入，入体一尺。
张远手掌一扭，刀锋绞断心肺，那匪寇口中鲜血溢出，身躯软倒。
没等其软倒，张远一脚踹出，正踹在这匪寇胸口。
其胸口肉眼可见塌陷，身躯撕开背后白帆，拉出一丈多长的血痕。
“嘣——”
没有了桅杆和船桨操控的木船，撞在河岸边。
船上匪寇东倒西歪，只有张远一人仿若脚下生根，丝毫不动。
content_en:
When people arrived on the deck, Zhang Yuan's right arm was immediately swung out with the long knife in a hanging arc.
"Whoops——"
The blade whirled against the side of the ship with a harsh scream.
The sharp blades passed in front of the four or five bandits who were controlling the oars and trying to pull the boat back to the middle of the river.
Blood, severed limbs.
There is also broken wood pulp.
The long knife struck the cabin with a "bang" sound, and the blade penetrated the wood two feet.
There were screams and wails all over the side of the ship.
Without people to paddle, the wooden boat swirled with the water in the river and crashed towards the shore.
"Kill him——"
"Get him off!"
Seeing that Zhang Yuan had no knife in his hand, several knife-wielding bandits roared and rushed towards him.
If they don't drive Zhang Yuan off the ship, they will die!
With his hands free, Zhang Yuan took a step forward and raised his arms.
Mountain boxing, move mountains to reach mountains.
"Bang——"
The two bandits who were slashed with long knives were knocked away and fell into the cabin two feet away. They smashed the five-inch thick wooden planks of the cabin and fell in.
This blow caused the other two charging bandits to stop in their tracks and look pale.
Too strong!
The strength displayed by Zhang Yuan was beyond their ability to deal with it.
Zhang Yuan kept walking and raised his left arm.
Progress, elbow bump.
Iron fist, hanging elbow.
"Bang——"
The thick mast broke at the sound, and the white canvas hanging on it fell with the mast, covering the cabin and deck, and also covering several bandits.
A long knife stabbed Zhang Yuan from between the canvas and the cable.
Zhang Yuan raised his left hand and moved his arm.
"When——"
The long knife broke.
Zhang Yuan stretched out his hand to grab the blade of the broken knife and stabbed it into the shoulder of the bandit who was drawing the knife. The blade penetrated his right shoulder and penetrated his body for a foot.
Zhang Yuan twisted his palm and the blade cut off his heart and lungs. Blood overflowed from the bandit's mouth and his body fell limp.
Before he could fall down, Zhang Yuan kicked out and hit the bandit in the chest.
His chest was visibly collapsed, and his body tore open the white sail on his back, pulling out a bloodstain more than a foot long.
"Boom——"
The wooden boat, without its mast and oars, crashed into the river bank.
The bandits on the ship were staggering around, but Zhang Yuan was the only one who seemed to have roots under his feet and did not move at all.
